statement.zh: 基什牛津—菲尔德博物馆联合发掘出土墓地与聚落语境；A 墓地见 Mackay 1925，Moorey 1978 为强二级重建并含牛津器物目录（不编造馆藏号）。
statement.en: At Kish, the Oxford–Field Museum joint expedition excavated cemetery and settlement contexts; the A Cemetery is documented in Mackay 1925, with Moorey 1978 providing a strong secondary reconstruction and Oxford object catalogue (no invented inventory numbers).
